title: Muškarac iz Čelinca preminuo od povreda, počela istraga za ubistvo
Man from Čelinac died of his injuries, murder investigation started
body: Okružno javno tužilaštvo u Banjoj Luci pokrenulo je istragu za ubistvo muškarca iz Čelinca.
The District Public Prosecutor's Office in Banja Luka has opened an investigation into the murder of a man from Čelinac.
Istraga se vodi protiv N. P. iz Laktaša.
The investigation is being led against N. P. from Laktaši.
Žrtva, D. S., preminula je u Univerzitetskom kliničkom centru Republike Srpske od povreda koje je zadobila 12. oktobra u Laktašima.
The victim, D. S., died in the University Clinical Centre of Republika Srpska from injuries he received on 12 October in Laktaši.
Vještak Zavoda za sudsku medicinu utvrdio je da je smrt nastupila na nasilan način.
An expert from the Institute of Forensic Medicine found that the death happened in a violent way.
Zato je tužilac odlučio da djelo kvalifikuje kao ubistvo, prema članu 124. Krivičnog zakona Republike Srpske.
Therefore the prosecutor decided to classify the act as murder, according to Article 124 of the Criminal Code of Republika Srpska.
Tužilac je naložio policiji u Banjoj Luci da pronađe osumnjičenog i dovede ga u tužilaštvo.
The prosecutor ordered the police in Banja Luka to find the suspect and bring him to the prosecutor's office.
Zvaničnici za sada nisu objavili više detalja o tome šta se dogodilo 12. oktobra.
Officials have not yet published more details about what happened on 12 October.

title: Poreski obveznici u FBiH uplatili 7,37 milijardi KM u deset mjeseci
Taxpayers in the FBiH paid 7.37 billion KM in ten months
body: Prema podacima Porezne uprave FBiH, poreski obveznici su od januara do oktobra 2026. uplatili 7,37 milijardi KM javnih prihoda.
According to data from the Tax Administration of the FBiH, taxpayers paid 7.37 billion KM of public revenue from January to October 2026.
To je 0,92 posto više nego u istom periodu prošle godine.
That is 0.92 percent more than in the same period last year.
Najviše je prikupljeno u Kantonu Sarajevo, oko 2,74 milijarde KM, a slijede Tuzlanski i Zeničko-dobojski kanton.
The most was collected in Sarajevo Canton, about 2.74 billion KM, followed by Tuzla Canton and Zenica-Doboj Canton.
Doprinosi su iznosili oko 5 milijardi KM, što je oko 48 miliona KM manje nego lani.
Contributions amounted to about 5 billion KM, which is about 48 million KM less than last year.
Doprinosi za PIO pali su za 2,68 posto, dok su doprinosi za zdravstveno osiguranje ostali skoro isti.
Contributions for pension insurance fell by 2.68 percent, while contributions for health insurance stayed almost the same.
Direktni porezi porasli su za 7,32 posto, a porez na dohodak za 10,24 posto.
Direct taxes grew by 7.32 percent, and income tax by 10.24 percent.
Fiskalni promet iznosio je više od 67 milijardi KM, što je 7,05 posto više nego lani.
Fiscal turnover was more than 67 billion KM, which is 7.05 percent more than last year.
Inspektori su ove godine obavili 4.411 kontrola.
Inspectors carried out 4,411 inspections this year.
Pronašli su 789 neprijavljenih radnika i zatvorili 388 objekata.
They found 789 unregistered workers and closed 388 premises.
Krajem oktobra bilo je zaposleno 547.658 osoba, a broj aktivnih firmi porastao je sa 134.348 na 138.511.
At the end of October 547,658 people were employed, and the number of active companies grew from 134,348 to 138,511.

title: Advokat porodice Jahić: Presuda je snažna poruka pravosuđa
Lawyer of the Jahić family: The verdict is a strong message from the judiciary
body: Nakon izricanja presude Anisu Kalajdžiću, novinarima je govorio advokat porodice Jahić, Damir Alić.
After the verdict against Anis Kalajdžić was announced, the lawyer of the Jahić family, Damir Alić, spoke to reporters.
Rekao je da je presuda važan prekretnica za pravosuđe u Bosni i Hercegovini.
He said that the verdict is an important turning point for the judiciary in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Prema njegovim riječima, to je najjača poruka koju je pravosuđe moglo poslati kada su u pitanju najteža krivična djela.
In his words, it is the strongest message the judiciary could send when it comes to the most serious crimes.
Alić vjeruje da će kazna spriječiti slične zločine u budućnosti.
Alić believes that the sentence will prevent similar crimes in the future.
Kako je rekao, svaki mogući počinitelj sada tačno zna šta ga čeka.
As he said, every possible perpetrator now knows exactly what awaits him.
Dodao je da je optuženi imao aktivnu odbranu i koristio svoja prava, ali bez uspjeha.
He added that the defendant had an active defence and used his rights, but without success.
Porodica je zadovoljna presudom.
The family is satisfied with the verdict.
Očekuje da će Vrhovni sud potvrditi kaznu ako optuženi uloži žalbu.
It expects the Supreme Court to confirm the sentence if the defendant files an appeal.
Slučaj je u BiH izazvao veliku pažnju jer se mnogi nadaju da će zaštita žena postati bolja.
The case drew great attention in BiH because many hope that the protection of women will become better.

title: Batmanov motocikl Batpod ide na aukciju u Londonu
Batman's motorcycle Batpod goes to auction in London
body: Batpod, motocikl koji je Christian Bale vozio u filmovima "Vitez tame" i "Vitez tame: Povratak", bit će prodat na aukciji u Londonu.
The Batpod, the motorcycle that Christian Bale rode in the films "The Dark Knight" and "The Dark Knight Rises", will be sold at an auction in London.
Aukcija će biti od 4. do 6. decembra, a organizuje je kuća Propstore.
The auction will be from 4 to 6 December, and it is organised by the Propstore company.
Procjena je da bi motocikl mogao koštati između 594.000 i 1,19 miliona dolara.
The estimate is that the motorcycle could cost between 594,000 and 1.19 million dollars.
Batpod je glavni predmet zimske aukcije filmskih i TV rekvizita, na kojoj će biti više od 1.400 predmeta.
The Batpod is the main item of the winter auction of film and TV props, at which there will be more than 1,400 items.
Njihova ukupna procijenjena vrijednost je 13,2 miliona dolara.
Their total estimated value is 13.2 million dollars.
Propstore navodi da je ovo možda motocikl iz scene potjere za Jokerom, jer ima tragove i ogrebotine na desnoj strani.
Propstore says this may be the motorcycle from the chase scene with the Joker, because it has marks and scratches on its right side.
Motocikl ima motor od 750 kubika i gume od 31 inča.
The motorcycle has a 750 cc engine and 31-inch tyres.
Osnivač Propstorea Stephen Lane rekao je da je Batpod izvanredan podvig filmske produkcije i inžinjeringa.
The founder of Propstore, Stephen Lane, said that the Batpod is an extraordinary feat of film production and engineering.
Dizajnirali su ga redatelj Christopher Nolan i scenograf Nathan Crowley.
It was designed by director Christopher Nolan and production designer Nathan Crowley.
Drugi Batpod iz istih filmova prodan je 2016. na aukciji u Londonu za oko 406.000 dolara.
Another Batpod from the same films was sold in 2016 at an auction in London for about 406,000 dollars.

title: Trump razmatra nastavak vojnih operacija protiv Irana
Trump is considering resuming military operations against Iran
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump sastao se sa svojim timom za nacionalnu sigurnost kako bi razgovarali o mogućem nastavku vojnih operacija protiv Irana.
US President Donald Trump met his national security team to discuss a possible resumption of military operations against Iran.
Visoki zvaničnici potvrdili su za Fox News da su sastanci u Bijeloj kući bili u srijedu i četvrtak.
Senior officials confirmed to Fox News that the meetings in the White House were on Wednesday and Thursday.
Oni kažu da je 9. novembar mladi mjesec na Bliskom istoku.
They say that 9 November is the new moon in the Middle East.
Noću tada ima malo mjesečine ili je uopće nema, što pogoduje vojnim operacijama.
At night there is then little or no moonlight, which favours military operations.
Trump je u četvrtak u Ovalnom uredu rekao da će Vašington odlučiti o nastavku rata.
On Thursday in the Oval Office Trump said that Washington would decide about continuing the war.
Pitao je da li Amerika treba nastaviti napade kako bi sigurno uništila iranski nuklearni program.
He asked whether America should continue the attacks to be sure to destroy the Iranian nuclear programme.
Rekao je i da bi radije ostatak zemlje ostavio netaknut, ali da će možda morati drugačije.
He also said he would rather leave the rest of the country untouched, but that he may have to act differently.
Doda je da će se to uskoro saznati.
He added that this will be known soon.
Centralna komanda američke vojske (CENTCOM) navodno završava pripreme, ali još nije dobila novu naredbu iz Vašingtona.
The US Central Command (CENTCOM) is reportedly finishing preparations, but it has not yet received a new order from Washington.
Premijer Iraka Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi rekao je Trumpu telefonom da se iračka teritorija ne smije koristiti za napade na susjedne zemlje.
Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Faleh Al-Zaidi told Trump by phone that Iraqi territory must not be used to attack neighbouring countries.

title: U Srbiji uhapšeno osam policajaca zbog smrti Dalibora Dragijevića
Eight police officers arrested in Serbia over the death of Dalibor Dragijević
body: Prema neslužbenim informacijama, u Srbiji je uhapšeno osam pripadnika Uprave kriminalističke policije.
According to unofficial information, eight members of the Criminal Police Directorate have been arrested in Serbia.
Radi se o istrazi smrti Dalibora Dragijevića, brata čovjeka koji je optužen za ubistvo dvogodišnje Danke Ilić.
The investigation concerns the death of Dalibor Dragijević, the brother of the man accused of murdering two-year-old Danka Ilić.
Zvanične potvrde hapšenja za sada nema.
There is no official confirmation of the arrests so far.
Hapšenje je naredilo Više javno tužilaštvo u Nišu, a očekuju se i nova hapšenja.
The arrests were ordered by the Higher Public Prosecutor's Office in Niš, and more arrests are expected.
Dalibor Dragijević bio je iz mjesta Zlot kod Bora.
Dalibor Dragijević was from the place Zlot near Bor.
U aprilu 2024. uhapšen je zbog sumnje da je pomogao bratu Dejanu da sakrije tijelo djevojčice.
In April 2024 he was arrested on suspicion that he helped his brother Dejan hide the girl's body.
Dejan Dragijević i Srđan Janković optuženi su za ubistvo Danke Ilić, a oboje poriču krivicu.
Dejan Dragijević and Srđan Janković are accused of the murder of Danka Ilić, and both deny guilt.
Nakon Daliborove smrti, MUP Srbije je saopštio da je preminuo prirodnom smrću u službenim prostorijama.
After Dalibor's death, the Serbian Interior Ministry said that he died of natural causes on official premises.
Portal Nova.rs piše da obdukcija to nije potvrdila.
The portal Nova.rs writes that the autopsy did not confirm this.
Prema tom izvoru, imao je više povreda, među njima slomljena rebra, i one su uzrok smrti.
According to that source, he had several injuries, among them broken ribs, and they were the cause of death.

title: Anis Kalajdžić osuđen na 45 godina zatvora za ubistvo u Mostaru
Anis Kalajdžić sentenced to 45 years in prison for the murder in Mostar
body: Kantonalni sud u Mostaru osudio je Anisa Kalajdžića na 45 godina zatvora zbog ubistva Aldine Jahić.
The Cantonal Court in Mostar sentenced Anis Kalajdžić to 45 years in prison for the murder of Aldina Jahić.
Presudu je izrekao sudija Darko Zovko, a ona još nije pravosnažna.
The verdict was delivered by judge Darko Zovko, and it is not yet final.
Aldina Jahić imala je 32 godine i bila je iz Kalesije.
Aldina Jahić was 32 years old and was from Kalesija.
Ubistvo se dogodilo 16. novembra 2025. oko 18:00 u Mostaru.
The murder happened on 16 November 2025 at around 18:00 in Mostar.
Prema optužnici, Kalajdžić je čekao ispred fitnes centra u kojem je Aldina trenirala i napao je više puta.
According to the indictment, Kalajdžić waited outside the fitness centre where Aldina trained and attacked her several times.
Ona je pobjegla prema obližnjem restoranu i tražila od prolaznika da pozovu policiju, ali ju je on našao u toaletu i pucao na nju iz pištolja.
She ran towards a nearby restaurant and asked passersby to call the police, but he found her in a toilet and shot her with a pistol.
Optužen je i za nezakonit posjed oružja te za prijetnje i uhođenje prije ubistva.
He was also charged with illegal possession of a weapon and with threats and stalking before the murder.
Tužiteljica Vesna Pranjić tražila je kaznu od 45 godina i rekla da je to rodno uvjetovano ubistvo.
Prosecutor Vesna Pranjić asked for a sentence of 45 years and said it was a gender-based murder.
Vještaci su utvrdili da je Kalajdžić u vrijeme djela bio smanjeno uračunljiv, ali ne bitno.
Experts found that Kalajdžić had diminished responsibility at the time of the act, but not significantly.
Njegov advokat nije osporavao ubistvo, ali je tvrdio da rodni motiv nije dokazan.
His lawyer did not dispute the murder, but claimed that a gender motive was not proven.
Kalajdžić je u posljednjoj riječi rekao da žali zbog onoga što se dogodilo, a presudu može pobijati žalbom pred Vrhovnim sudom FBiH.
In his last words Kalajdžić said he regrets what happened, and he can challenge the verdict with an appeal to the Supreme Court of the FBiH.

title: Rockstar objavio 39 novih slika iz igre GTA 6
Rockstar released 39 new pictures from the game GTA 6
body: Kompanija Rockstar Games objavila je na svojoj web-stranici 39 novih slika iz igre GTA VI.
The company Rockstar Games published 39 new pictures from the game GTA VI on its website.
Igra izlazi 19. novembra, dakle za manje od dvije sedmice.
The game comes out on 19 November, so in less than two weeks.
Galerija se zove "Launch Gallery", a uz nju je poruka: "Vidimo se u Leonidi 19. novembra".
The gallery is called "Launch Gallery", and with it came the message: "See you in Leonida on 19 November".
Na slikama se vide nove scene iz grada Vice City, njegovi stanovnici i zločini koje čine glavni likovi, Jason i Lucia.
The pictures show new scenes from the city of Vice City, its residents and the crimes committed by the main characters, Jason and Lucia.
Radnja se odvija u izmišljenoj američkoj državi Leonida.
The story takes place in the fictional American state of Leonida.
Prošlo je 13 godina od izlaska igre GTA V, koja je objavljena 2013.
13 years have passed since the release of GTA V, which came out in 2013.
Posljednji najavni video objavljen je 15. oktobra, a reklame se pojavljuju na televiziji, bilbordima i autobusima širom svijeta.
The last trailer was published on 15 October, and ads appear on television, billboards and buses around the world.
Najveća promocija je u Miamiju, koji je bio inspiracija za Vice City.
The biggest promotion is in Miami, which was the inspiration for Vice City.
Dan prije izlaska, 18. novembra, Rockstar i košarkaški klub Miami Heat organizuju događaj "A Night in Vice City".
The day before the release, on 18 November, Rockstar and the basketball club Miami Heat are organising the event "A Night in Vice City".
Igra izlazi za PlayStation 5 i Xbox Series X|S, a preuzimanje počinje 10. novembra.
The game comes out for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, and the download starts on 10 November.
Prema portalu IGN, trebat će joj 212 GB prostora.
According to the portal IGN, it will need 212 GB of space.

title: Kardiohirurg otkrio šta jede, a šta izbjegava nakon srčanog udara
Heart surgeon reveals what he eats and what he avoids after a heart attack
body: Američki kardiohirurg Jeremy London ima više od 25 godina iskustva i prije oko četiri godine imao je srčani udar.
The American heart surgeon Jeremy London has more than 25 years of experience and had a heart attack about four years ago.
U tekstu za CNBC opisao je šta kupuje svake sedmice da bi sačuvao srce.
In a text for CNBC he described what he buys every week to protect his heart.
Prvo pravilo je da 80 posto vremena u prodavnici provede uz vanjske police.
The first rule is to spend 80 percent of the time in the shop along the outer shelves.
U unutrašnjim redovima, kaže, uglavnom su visokoprerađeni proizvodi, pa tamo ostaje najviše 20 posto vremena.
In the inner aisles, he says, there are mostly ultra-processed products, so he spends at most 20 percent of the time there.
Njegova sedmična lista ima pet grupa: voće, povrće, vlakna, proteine i zdrave masti.
His weekly list has five groups: fruit, vegetables, fibre, protein and healthy fats.
Kupuje, na primjer, borovnice, trešnje, brokolu, špinat, zob, sočivo, piletinu, divlji losos, jaja i maslinovo ulje.
He buys, for example, blueberries, cherries, broccoli, spinach, oats, lentils, chicken, wild salmon, eggs and olive oil.
Svaki dan pije smuti od trešanja, borovnica, bademovog maslaca i bademovog mlijeka.
Every day he drinks a smoothie made of cherries, blueberries, almond butter and almond milk.
Izbjegava hrenovke, suhomesnate proizvode, slatka gazirana pića, bijeli hljeb, peciva, torte i alkohol.
He avoids hot dogs, cold cuts, sugary fizzy drinks, white bread, pastries, cakes and alcohol.
Visokoprerađena hrana je, prema njemu, jedan od najvećih uzroka hroničnih bolesti.
Ultra-processed food is, according to him, one of the biggest causes of chronic diseases.
Povećava rizik od dijabetesa tipa 2 i bolesti srca i krvnih sudova.
It increases the risk of type 2 diabetes and of diseases of the heart and blood vessels.
Savjetuje da se ne vjeruje natpisima na prednjoj strani pakovanja, poput „prirodno“ ili „sa malo masti“.
He advises not to trust the labels on the front of the package, such as “natural” or “low fat”.
Bolje je pročitati listu sastojaka: što je kraća, to je bolje.
It is better to read the list of ingredients: the shorter it is, the better.
Preporučuje i kupovinu sa spiskom i nikad na prazan stomak.
He also recommends shopping with a list and never on an empty stomach.

title: Stanivuković odbio saradnju sa SNSD-om i najavio billboarde
Stanivuković rejected cooperation with SNSD and announced billboards
body: Gradonačelnik Banje Luke Draško Stanivuković kaže da njegov Pokret „Sigurna Srpska“ neće sarađivati sa SNSD-om.
Banja Luka mayor Draško Stanivuković says that his Movement “Sigurna Srpska” will not cooperate with SNSD.
Govorio je na televiziji BN nakon izbora.
He spoke on the BN television station after the elections.
„Nema opcije za koaliciju sa SNSD-om, to za mene uopće nije pitanje“, rekao je.
“There is no option for a coalition with SNSD, for me that is not even a question,” he said.
Dodao je da i dalje nema ulaska u vlast s trenutnim režimom.
He added that there is still no entering the government with the current regime.
Stanivuković je objasnio da je zakupio billboarde u Banjoj Luci.
Stanivuković explained that he rented billboards in Banja Luka.
Na njima je htio prikazati one koje naziva „papcima“ i prebjezima, to jest političare koji mijenjaju stranu.
On them he wanted to show those he calls “papci” and defectors, that is, politicians who change sides.
Prema njegovim riječima, ipak ih nisu objesili.
According to him, however, they did not put them up.
Smatra da je razotkrivanje političke trgovine trebalo početi još 2014. godine.
He thinks that exposing political trading should have started as early as 2014.
Rekao je i da borba protiv korupcije poslije izbora mora biti prioritet.
He also said that the fight against corruption after the elections must be a priority.
Podrška nacionalnim pitanjima, kaže, ne zavisi od podjele funkcija u vlasti.
Support for national issues, he says, does not depend on the sharing of government posts.
Čestitao je pobjednicima izbora u Srbiji i rekao da je spreman na saradnju sa svim budućim zvaničnicima.
He congratulated the winners of the election in Serbia and said he is ready to cooperate with all future officials.

title: Tri osobe optužene da su uz pomoć AI-ja ukrale 129 miliona dolara
Three people charged with stealing $129 million with the help of AI
body: Tužioci u SAD-u optužili su tri osobe da su pomoću vještačke inteligencije imitirale direktore firmi i ukrale oko 129 miliona dolara.
Prosecutors in the US have charged three people with using artificial intelligence to imitate company executives and stealing about 129 million dollars.
Optuženi su Jacob Soall (41), Sharon Hazan (54) i Guy Sheetrit (42), koji su povezani sa Španijom, Britanijom, Izraelom i UAE.
The accused are Jacob Soall (41), Sharon Hazan (54) and Guy Sheetrit (42), who are linked to Spain, Britain, Israel and the UAE.
Optužbe su podignute pred saveznim sudom u New Yorku, a odnose se na elektronsku prevaru, krađu identiteta i pranje novca.
The charges were filed in a federal court in New York, and they concern electronic fraud, identity theft and money laundering.
Grupa je navodno više od godinu i po dana napadala hiljade firmi širom svijeta, uglavnom njihova računovodstva.
The group allegedly attacked thousands of companies around the world for more than a year and a half, mostly their accounting departments.
Zaposlenima su slali e-poruke kao da su direktori, a zatim su dogovarali telefonske ili video pozive.
They sent employees emails as if they were executives, and then arranged phone or video calls.
Na tim pozivima je vještačka inteligencija oponašala glas, a ponekad i izgled direktora.
On those calls artificial intelligence imitated the voice, and sometimes the appearance, of the executive.
Zatim su žrtvama rekli da se jave advokatu velike firme, kojeg su također glumili.
Then they told the victims to contact a lawyer from a big firm, whom they also played.
Lažni advokat tražio je da zaposleni pošalju velike iznose na račune u raznim zemljama.
The fake lawyer asked employees to send large sums to accounts in various countries.
Novac je potom pretvoren u kriptovalute da bi se sakrilo odakle dolazi, pa je podijeljen među osumnjičenima.
The money was then turned into cryptocurrency to hide where it came from, and was split among the suspects.
Među žrtvama su bolnice u Missouriju i Kaliforniji, banka u Rhode Islandu i firma za hranu za kućne ljubimce na Floridi.
Among the victims are hospitals in Missouri and California, a bank in Rhode Island and a pet food company in Florida.
Za svaku prevaru zaprijećena je kazna do 20 godina zatvora.
For each fraud charge the penalty is up to 20 years in prison.
Zvaničnik FBI-ja rekao je da će se ta agencija brzo prilagođavati kriminalcima koji koriste nove tehnologije.
An FBI official said that the agency will adapt quickly to criminals who use new technologies.

title: Raguž: političan utjecaj na Centralnu banku bio bi udar na BiH
Raguž: political influence on the Central Bank would hit BiH
body: Predsjednik HRS-a Slaven Raguž komentarisao je rezultate općih izbora u razgovoru za BHRT.
HRS president Slaven Raguž commented on the general election results in an interview for BHRT.
Kaže da Hrvatska petorka nije postigla najveće ciljeve, ali da je njegova stranka malo narasla.
He says that the Croat Five did not reach their biggest goals, but that his party grew a little.
HRS je spreman preuzeti odgovornost u vlasti, ali se neće gurati niti biti „ičiji privjesak“.
HRS is ready to take responsibility in government, but it will not push its way in or be “anyone's appendage”.
Sa HDZ-om nije bilo zvaničnih razgovora, nego samo neformalnih kontakata.
There were no official talks with HDZ, only informal contacts.
Raguž smatra da bi SDA, HDZ BiH i SDP matematički mogli formirati većinu.
Raguž thinks that SDA, HDZ BiH and SDP could mathematically form a majority.
Ipak, ostaje otvoreno hoće li se napraviti drugačiji blok.
Still, it remains open whether a different bloc will be made.
Očekuje da će se obrisi nove vlade u Federaciji vidjeti oko četvrtog ili petog mjeseca iduće godine.
He expects the outlines of the new government in the Federation to be seen around the fourth or fifth month of next year.
Ne isključuje ni ponovljene izbore u Federaciji, iako misli da će se dogovor vjerovatno postići.
He does not rule out repeat elections in the Federation either, although he thinks a deal will probably be reached.
Raguž kaže da se, nažalost, nada četirima godinama stagnacije i bavljenja samim sobom.
Raguž says that, unfortunately, he expects four years of stagnation and of politicians dealing with themselves.
Zahtjeve vezane za Centralnu banku BiH i valutni odbor smatra ozbiljnim udarom na ekonomske temelje države.
He sees the demands about the Central Bank of BiH and the currency board as a serious blow to the economic foundations of the country.
Prema njegovim riječima, politički utjecaj otvorio bi vrata zaduživanju, inflaciji i štampanju novca.
According to him, political influence would open the door to borrowing, inflation and printing money.
Predložio je i da plate političara budu vezane za rezultate njihovog rada.
He also proposed that politicians' salaries be tied to the results of their work.

title: Mississippi: demokrata Colom ima prednost od 1.882 glasa
Mississippi: Democrat Colom leads by 1,882 votes
body: Trka za mjesto u američkom Senatu u Mississippiju još nije završena.
The race for a seat in the US Senate in Mississippi is not over yet.
Hiljade listića još nije prebrojano, a rezultat je vrlo tijesan.
Thousands of ballots have not been counted yet, and the result is very close.
Demokrata Scott Colom povećao je prednost nad republikankom Cindy Hyde-Smith na 1.882 glasa.
Democrat Scott Colom has increased his lead over Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith to 1,882 votes.
Dan nakon izbora razlika je bila samo 43 glasa, ali se ovi podaci još ne smatraju zvaničnim.
The day after the election the difference was only 43 votes, but these figures are still not considered official.
Prema NBC-u, prebrojano je oko 95,7 posto očekivanih glasova, a ostalo ih je oko 44.000.
According to NBC, about 95.7 percent of the expected votes have been counted, and about 44,000 remain.
Najviše neprebrojanih listića je u okrugu Hinds, gdje je glavni grad Jackson i gdje češće pobjeđuju demokrate.
Most uncounted ballots are in Hinds County, where the capital Jackson is and where Democrats win more often.
Tamo je u srijedu ostalo oko 9.000 listića.
About 9,000 ballots were left there on Wednesday.
U okrugu Rankin, koji je republikanski, Hyde-Smith vodi sa 61,7 prema 36,1 posto.
In Rankin County, which is Republican, Hyde-Smith leads 61.7 to 36.1 percent.
Birači koji nisu mogli odmah potvrditi pravo glasa, na primjer bez dokumenta s fotografijom, glasali su privremenim listićima.
Voters who could not confirm their right to vote immediately, for example without a photo ID, voted with provisional ballots.
Do 10. novembra moraju pokazati lični dokument u sudu svog okruga, inače im glas neće biti brojan.
By 10 November they must show an ID at their county court, otherwise their vote will not be counted.
Poštanski listići se priznaju ako su poslani do dana izbora i stignu u roku od pet radnih dana.
Mail ballots are accepted if they were sent by Election Day and arrive within five working days.
Kampanja Hyde-Smith tražila je da svi okruzi odvojeno čuvaju privremene listiće, a Colomov tim to je nazvao očajničkim potezom.
The Hyde-Smith campaign asked all counties to keep provisional ballots separate, and Colom's team called this a desperate move.

title: Danas sunčano na jugu BiH, a sutra u cijeloj zemlji
Sunny in the south of BiH today, and in the whole country tomorrow
body: Prema prognozi Federalnog hidrometeorološkog zavoda, danas će na jugu i jugozapadu BiH biti pretežno sunčano.
According to the forecast of the Federal Hydrometeorological Institute, it will be mostly sunny today in the south and southwest of BiH.
Drugdje će biti pretežno oblačno, a poslijepodne se očekuje djelomično razvedravanje.
Elsewhere it will be mostly cloudy, and partial clearing is expected in the afternoon.
Ujutro je moguća magla u Bihaću i Bugojnu.
In the morning fog is possible in Bihać and Bugojno.
Vjetar će biti slab, istočnog i sjeveroistočnog smjera.
The wind will be light, from the east and northeast.
Jutarnja temperatura kretat će se od 2 stepena u Livnu do 7 stepeni u Mostaru.
The morning temperature will range from 2 degrees in Livno to 7 degrees in Mostar.
Najviša dnevna temperatura bit će od 6 stepeni u Bihaću do 15 stepeni u Mostaru.
The highest daytime temperature will be from 6 degrees in Bihać to 15 degrees in Mostar.
U Sarajevu će biti umjereno oblačno, oko 4 stepena ujutro i oko 8 stepeni preko dana.
In Sarajevo it will be moderately cloudy, about 4 degrees in the morning and about 8 degrees during the day.
Sutra će u cijeloj zemlji biti sunčano uz umjerenu oblačnost.
Tomorrow it will be sunny in the whole country with moderate cloud.
U dolinama i uz rijeke moguća je magla ili niski oblaci.
In valleys and along rivers fog or low clouds are possible.
Ujutro će biti od -1 do 5 stepeni, a preko dana od 5 do 11 stepeni, na jugu do 18.
In the morning it will be from -1 to 5 degrees, and during the day from 5 to 11 degrees, in the south up to 18.
U nedjelju će biti pretežno oblačno, a poslijepodne i noću lokalno je moguća slaba kiša.
On Sunday it will be mostly cloudy, and in the afternoon and at night light rain is possible locally.

title: Bijela kuća poručila konzervativnim grupama: pratimo vas
The White House told conservative groups: we are watching you
body: Bijela kuća je poslala pismo više od 3.000 konzervativnih organizacija.
The White House sent a letter to more than 3,000 conservative organizations.
Pismo je stiglo dva dana nakon što su republikanci izgubili kontrolu nad oba doma Kongresa.
The letter arrived two days after the Republicans lost control of both houses of Congress.
Šalje ga ured Bijele kuće koji sarađuje sa organizacijama izvan vlade.
It was sent by the White House office that works with organizations outside the government.
Voditelji dviju poznatih organizacija potvrdili su listu Wall Street Journal da su ga primili.
Leaders of two well-known organizations confirmed to the Wall Street Journal that they received it.
U pismu piše da Bijela kuća, kao i uvijek, prati izjave, saopćenja i nastupe tih organizacija u medijima.
The letter says that the White House, as always, follows the statements, press releases and media appearances of these organizations.
Navode se i dostignuća predsjednika Donalda Trumpa.
The achievements of President Donald Trump are also listed.
Obećava se da će demokratama biti onemogućeno da ponište Trumpove politike.
It promises that the Democrats will be prevented from overturning Trump's policies.
Ranije poruke Bijele kuće tražile su da organizacije podijele izjave podrške, ali nisu spominjale praćenje.
Earlier White House messages asked organizations to share statements of support, but they did not mention monitoring.
Glasnogovornica Bijele kuće rekla je da pismo nije prijetnja nego pokušaj da se podržavatelji mobiliziraju.
A White House spokeswoman said that the letter is not a threat but an attempt to mobilize supporters.
Dodala je da je ured i ranije koristio sličan jezik.
She added that the office has used similar language before.
Prema listu, konzervativna koalicija oko Trumpa počinje se raspadati.
According to the paper, the conservative coalition around Trump is starting to fall apart.
Neki ugledni republikanci krive za poraz Trumpove carine i rat s Iranom.
Some prominent Republicans blame Trump's tariffs and the war with Iran for the defeat.

title: Azijske berze u padu: Tajvan i Južna Koreja izgubili više od 8 posto
Asian stock markets fall: Taiwan and South Korea lost more than 8 percent
body: Berze na Tajvanu i u Južnoj Koreji pale su u petak ujutro za više od 8 posto.
Stock markets in Taiwan and South Korea fell by more than 8 percent on Friday morning.
Razlog je veliko rasprodavanje dionica tehnoloških kompanija i kompanija vezanih za vještačku inteligenciju.
The reason is a big sell-off of shares of technology companies and companies linked to artificial intelligence.
Tajvanski indeks TAIEX izgubio je na početku trgovanja više od 3.700 bodova, ali su gubici do podne djelomično smanjeni.
The Taiwanese index TAIEX lost more than 3,700 points at the start of trading, but by midday the losses were partly reduced.
Južnokorejski KOSPI pao je za oko 500 bodova, odnosno 8,6 posto, na 4.923,47.
The South Korean KOSPI fell by about 500 points, or 8.6 percent, to 4,923.47.
Trgovanje u Seulu je privremeno zaustavljeno, a indeks je prvi put u devet mjeseci pao ispod 5.000 bodova.
Trading in Seoul was temporarily stopped, and the index fell below 5,000 points for the first time in nine months.
KOSPI je već u četvrtak pao 5,3 posto, a u petak je u najgorem trenutku bio gotovo 15 posto ispod srijede.
KOSPI had already fallen 5.3 percent on Thursday, and on Friday at its worst moment it was almost 15 percent below Wednesday.
Američka tržišta imala su najveći pad od aprila 2025, kada je Trump najavio carine.
US markets had their biggest fall since April 2025, when Trump announced tariffs.
Nasdaq je u četvrtak pao 5,52 posto, S&P 500 pao je 4,36 posto, a Dow Jones 3,44 posto.
On Thursday the Nasdaq fell 5.52 percent, the S&P 500 fell 4.36 percent, and the Dow Jones 3.44 percent.
Investitori strahuju da bi pobjede demokrata na izborima za Kongres mogle zaustaviti gradnju novih data centara.
Investors fear that Democratic wins in the Congress elections could stop the building of new data centers.
Boje se i strožeg nadzora nad vještačkom inteligencijom, a već ranije su sumnjali hoće li se ogromna ulaganja isplatiti.
They also fear stricter oversight of artificial intelligence, and they already doubted earlier whether the huge investments would pay off.
Tajvanski zamjenik ministra finansija Frank Juan rekao je da su osnove tržišta „dobre i stabilne“.
Taiwan's deputy finance minister Frank Juan said that the market's fundamentals are “good and stable”.
Dodao je da bi se, ako dođe do poremećaja, mogao sastati državni stabilizacijski fond i intervenisati na tržištu.
He added that, if there is a disruption, the state stabilization fund could meet and intervene in the market.

title: Trump: dogovor Moskve i Kijeva mogao bi obuhvatiti cijelu Evropu
Trump: a deal between Moscow and Kyiv could cover all of Europe
body: Američki predsjednik Donald Trump rekao je da je sukob Rusije i Ukrajine „vrlo blizu rješenja“.
US President Donald Trump said that the conflict between Russia and Ukraine is “very close to a solution”.
Prema njegovim riječima, dogovor bi mogao obuhvatiti i druge evropske zemlje, a ne samo Ukrajinu.
According to him, a deal could include other European countries, not only Ukraine.
Trump očekuje da će rat uskoro završiti, ali nije rekao kada.
Trump expects the war to end soon, but he did not say when.
U Bijeloj kući sastao se s Kirilom Dmitrijevim, posebnim izaslanikom ruskog predsjednika.
At the White House he met Kirill Dmitriev, the special envoy of the Russian president.
Nije objasnio o čemu su razgovarali.
He did not explain what they talked about.
Trumpov zet Jared Kushner napisao je na mreži X da SAD žele riješiti sigurnosne brige svih strana.
Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner wrote on X that the US wants to solve the security worries of all sides.
Prema njemu, to treba uraditi praktičnim rješenjima oko kojih se svi slože, kako bi se smanjio rizik od novih sukoba.
According to him, this should be done with practical solutions that everyone agrees on, so the risk of new conflicts is smaller.
Prvoj dami Melaniji Trump u Bijeloj kući su bili gosti ruski i ukrajinski zvaničnici.
First Lady Melania Trump hosted Russian and Ukrainian officials at the White House.
Razgovarali su o humanitarnom primirju u Oleškiju, gradu na liniji fronta u regiji Herson koji je pod ruskom kontrolom.
They talked about the humanitarian ceasefire in Oleshky, a town on the front line in the Kherson region that is under Russian control.
Primirje je potpisano 23. oktobra i trajalo je od 27. oktobra do 1. novembra.
The ceasefire was signed on 23 October and lasted from 27 October to 1 November.
U tom razdoblju su stigla pomoć i evakuacija civila, jer su stanovnici imali malo hrane i osnovnih potrepština.
In that period aid arrived and civilians were evacuated, because the residents had little food and basic supplies.

title: U Sarajevu otvorena izložba dizajnera Branka Bačanovića
Exhibition of designer Branko Bačanović opened in Sarajevo
body: U Umjetničkoj galeriji Bosne i Hercegovine u Sarajevu otvorena je izložba „Koncepti“ grafičkog dizajnera Branka Bačanovića.
The exhibition “Koncepti” (Concepts) by graphic designer Branko Bačanović has opened at the Art Gallery of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Sarajevo.
Organizator je Akademija nauka i umjetnosti BiH, a posjetitelji je mogu razgledati do 28. novembra.
The organizer is the Academy of Sciences and Arts of BiH, and visitors can see it until 28 November.
Izložba pokazuje kako nastaje dizajn, a ne samo gotove radove.
The exhibition shows how design is made, not only finished works.
Zato su na njoj skice, bilješke, radne verzije i studije slova.
That is why it has sketches, notes, working versions and studies of lettering.
Prikazano je oko 700 radova, od autorovih studentskih dana do danas.
About 700 works are shown, from the author's student days until today.
Mnogi od njih dokumentuju skoro sve sarajevske pozorišne premijere, kao i brojne izložbe i kulturne događaje.
Many of them document almost all Sarajevo theatre premieres, as well as many exhibitions and cultural events.
Građa je uglavnom iz autorove privatne arhive i prvi put se javno prikazuje.
The material is mostly from the author's private archive and is shown to the public for the first time.
Izložba prati put od ručnog crtanja i kolaža do računara.
The exhibition follows the path from hand drawing and collage to the computer.
Bačanović radi više od trideset godina i jedan je od pionira grafičkog dizajna u BiH.
Bačanović has worked for more than thirty years and is one of the pioneers of graphic design in BiH.
Rekao je da se njegov način rada nije promijenio, nego samo brzina.
He said that his way of working has not changed, only the speed.
Posao koji je nekad trajao 20 dana sada se može završiti za jedan ili dva dana.
A job that once took 20 days can now be finished in one or two days.
Direktor galerije Strajo Krsmanović rekao je da se društvo može ponositi ovakvom izložbom.
The gallery director Strajo Krsmanović said that a society can be proud of such an exhibition.
Planira se i publikacija sa reprodukcijama i stručnim tekstovima, a promocija bi bila krajem januara.
A publication with reproductions and expert texts is also planned, and its promotion would be at the end of January.

title: Konačni rezultati u Srbiji: studentima 140 poslaničkih mjesta
Final results in Serbia: 140 seats for the students
body: Republička izborna komisija Srbije objavila je konačne rezultate parlamentarnih izbora.
Serbia's Republic Electoral Commission has published the final results of the parliamentary election.
Studentska lista „Studenti pobeđuju“ osvojila je 140 od ukupno 250 mjesta u Narodnoj skupštini.
The student list “Studenti pobeđuju” (“Students are winning”) won 140 of the 250 seats in the National Assembly.
To je više od polovine, pa studenti imaju apsolutnu većinu.
That is more than half, so the students have an absolute majority.
Lista Aleksandra Vučića dobila je 103 mjesta i bit će druga po snazi.
Aleksandar Vučić's list won 103 seats and will be the second strongest.
Lista Ivice Dačića osvojila je 94.766 glasova, odnosno 2,16 posto.
Ivica Dačić's list won 94,766 votes, or 2.16 percent.
Zato nije prešla cenzus, to jest najmanji potreban rezultat, i neće imati poslanika.
That is why it did not pass the threshold, that is, the minimum result needed, and it will have no MPs.
Savez vojvođanskih Mađara i Albanska koalicija imat će po 2 poslanika.
The Alliance of Vojvodina Hungarians and the Albanian coalition will have 2 MPs each.
Po jednog poslanika dobile su liste Rasima Ljajića, Usame Zukorlića i SDA Čuvari Sandžaka.
The lists of Rasim Ljajić, Usame Zukorlić and SDA Čuvari Sandžaka got one MP each.
Tako u skupštinu ulaze i 2 bošnjačka zastupnika iz Sandžaka.
This means that 2 Bosniak representatives from Sandžak are also entering the assembly.
Ovo su bili vanredni parlamentarni izbori, a održani su 25. oktobra.
These were early parliamentary elections, and they were held on 25 October.
Konačni rezultati vrlo su slični prvim procjenama koje su objavljene odmah nakon izbora.
The final results are very similar to the first estimates that were published right after the election.

title: Nithya Raman postaje nova gradonačelnica Los Angelesa
Nithya Raman becomes the new mayor of Los Angeles
body: Nithya Raman pobijedila je na izborima za gradonačelnicu Los Angelesa.
Nithya Raman has won the election for mayor of Los Angeles.
Ova 45-godišnja članica Demokratskih socijalista Amerike pobijedila je dosadašnju gradonačelnicu Karen Bass.
This 45-year-old member of the Democratic Socialists of America defeated the outgoing mayor, Karen Bass.
Pobjedu je objavila agencija Associated Press, a Los Angeles je drugi najveći grad u SAD-u.
The Associated Press agency announced the victory, and Los Angeles is the second-largest city in the US.
Prema New York Timesu, presudni su bili mlađi birači i ljudi koji žive u iznajmljenim stanovima.
According to the New York Times, younger voters and people who live in rented flats were decisive.
Za njih je život u ovom skupom gradu sve teži.
For them, life in this expensive city is getting harder and harder.
Raman je u kampanji govorila o stanovanju, beskućništvu i cijenama najma.
In the campaign, Raman talked about housing, homelessness and rents.
Tvrdila je da gradska uprava ne rješava ni osnovne probleme, poput rupa na cestama.
She claimed that the city administration does not solve even basic problems, such as potholes in the roads.
Raman je rođena u Indiji, studirala je na Harvardu i 6 godina je bila u Gradskom vijeću.
Raman was born in India, studied at Harvard and spent 6 years on the City Council.
Bit će prva žena južnoazijskog porijekla na čelu Los Angelesa.
She will be the first woman of South Asian origin to lead Los Angeles.
Los Angeles je tako treći veliki američki grad koji će voditi demokratski socijalist.
Los Angeles thus becomes the third big American city to be led by a democratic socialist.
Druga dva su New York, s gradonačelnikom Zohranom Mamdanijem, i Washington.
The other two are New York, with mayor Zohran Mamdani, and Washington.

title: Borac izgubio u Švedskoj nakon mnogo promašenih prilika
Borac lose in Sweden after missing many chances
body: Nogometaši Borca večeras su u Švedskoj izgubili od Mjällbyja rezultatom 0:2.
Borac's footballers lost 0:2 to Mjällby in Sweden tonight.
Utakmica trećeg kola Konferencijske lige igrala se na stadionu u Helsingborgu.
The third-round Conference League match was played at the stadium in Helsingborg.
Prvak Bosne i Hercegovine tako je doživio drugi poraz u ovom takmičenju.
The champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina thus suffered its second defeat in this competition.
Borac je bolje počeo i imao nekoliko odličnih prilika u prvom poluvremenu.
Borac started better and had several excellent chances in the first half.
Golman domaćih Lundin odbranio je udarce Cipetića i Roguljića.
The home goalkeeper, Lundin, saved shots from Cipetić and Roguljić.
Mjällby je svoju prvu priliku imao tek u 29. minuti.
Mjällby had its first chance only in the 29th minute.
Najveću priliku pred kraj poluvremena imao je Juričić, ali nije pogodio gol iz blizine.
Juričić had the biggest chance near the end of the half, but he missed the goal from close range.
U 54. minuti Bergstrom je iskoristio veliku grešku odbrane Borca i postigao gol.
In the 54th minute, Bergstrom took advantage of a big mistake in Borac's defence and scored.
Borac je zatim napadao, a u 88. minuti Enggaard je nakon brzog kontranapada postigao drugi gol.
Borac then attacked, and in the 88th minute Enggaard scored the second goal after a fast counter-attack.
Nakon ovog kola Borac je pao na 19. mjesto i ima 3 boda.
After this round, Borac dropped to 19th place and has 3 points.
Tim Vinka Marinovića ostao je bez gola iako je dugo bio bolji na terenu.
Vinko Marinović's team failed to score although it was the better side on the pitch for a long time.

title: Dojave o bombama: kako borbeni avioni presreću putničke letove
Bomb threats: how fighter jets intercept passenger flights
body: Ove sedmice lažne dojave o bombama pogodile su više od 20 letova u Evropi.
This week, fake bomb threats hit more than 20 flights in Europe.
U četvrtak ujutro hrvatski borbeni avion Rafale presreo je putnički avion Finnaira iznad Hrvatske.
On Thursday morning, a Croatian Rafale fighter jet intercepted a Finnair passenger plane over Croatia.
Avion je letio iz Helsinkija za Rim, a lovac ga je pratio do granice s Italijom.
The plane was flying from Helsinki to Rome, and the fighter escorted it to the border with Italy.
Eksploziv nije pronađen ni u jednom avionu, a još se ne zna ko šalje prijetnje.
No explosives were found on any plane, and it is still not known who is sending the threats.
Kada postoji sumnja na opasnost, NATO-ov centar u španskom Torrejonu naređuje hitno polijetanje.
When a danger is suspected, NATO's centre in Torrejón, Spain, orders an emergency take-off.
Piloti su u pripravnosti 24 sata, a prema NATO-u imaju 15 minuta da se spreme i polete.
The pilots are on standby 24 hours a day, and according to NATO they have 15 minutes to get ready and take off.
Nakon polijetanja kontrolori sa zemlje javljaju im smjer, visinu i udaljenost do aviona.
After take-off, controllers on the ground give them the direction, altitude and distance to the plane.
Lovac prilazi dovoljno blizu da vidi avion, ali drži sigurnu udaljenost.
The fighter gets close enough to see the plane but keeps a safe distance.
Ako nema radio-veze, lovac ljulja krilima ispred putničkog aviona.
If there is no radio contact, the fighter rocks its wings in front of the passenger plane.
Taj znak znači: presretnuti ste, slijedite me.
This signal means: you have been intercepted, follow me.
Ako postoji sumnja da bi avion mogao biti oružje za napad, komandu preuzimaju nacionalne vlasti.
If there is a suspicion that the plane could be used as a weapon for an attack, national authorities take command.

title: Muzičar Dede Putra nakon 13 godina snimio pjesmu o nacionalizmu
Musician Dede Putra records a song about nationalism after 13 years
body: Kemal Delalić iz Cazina, poznatiji kao Dede Putra, objavio je novu pjesmu.
Kemal Delalić from Cazin, better known as Dede Putra, has released a new song.
Pjesma se zove „Kupi nam ljubavi nacionalizma“, a tekst je napisao još prije 13 godina.
The song is called “Kupi nam ljubavi nacionalizma” (“Buy us nationalism, my love”), and he wrote the lyrics 13 years ago.
Tada je obećao da će je snimiti kada Sejdić i Finci postanu konstitutivni.
At the time he promised to record it when Sejdić and Finci become constituent.
To se nije desilo, ali pjesmu je ipak snimio.
That did not happen, but he recorded the song anyway.
Delalić kaže da je pjesmu ponovo aktivirao zbog promjene vlasti u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Delalić says he brought the song back because of the change of government in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Prema njegovim riječima, nacionalističke snage ponovo su raširile krila.
According to him, nationalist forces have spread their wings again.
Smatra i da se društvo u posljednjih 13 godina nije mnogo promijenilo.
He also thinks society has not changed much in the last 13 years.
Novu pjesmu pjeva u duetu s Aishom, ženskim glasom koji je napravila umjetna inteligencija.
He sings the new song as a duet with Aisha, a female voice made by artificial intelligence.
Delalić je bio pjevač i gitarista benda Dede Putra, koji je 2013. objavio prvi album.
Delalić was the singer and guitarist of the band Dede Putra, which released its first album in 2013.
Danas živi u Njemačkoj, gdje radi u bolnici, a u slobodno vrijeme snima u svom studiju.
Today he lives in Germany, where he works in a hospital, and in his free time he records in his own studio.
Kaže da je otišao jer nije želio da njegova kćerka odrasta u BiH.
He says he left because he did not want his daughter to grow up in BiH.
Političari o kojima je pjevao nikada mu nisu odgovorili, ali su njihove pristalice slale prijetnje.
The politicians he sang about never answered him, but their supporters sent threats.

title: Otečeni prsti kralja Charlesa ponovo zabrinuli korisnike mreža
King Charles's swollen fingers worry social media users again
body: Nove fotografije britanskog kralja Charlesa III s Kariba ponovo su pokrenule priču o njegovim prstima.
New photos of British King Charles III from the Caribbean have once again started talk about his fingers.
Kralj (77) bio je u posjeti Antigvi i Barbudi, a na slikama se vide otečeni prsti.
The King (77) was visiting Antigua and Barbuda, and swollen fingers can be seen in the pictures.
Mnogi korisnici društvenih mreža napisali su da su zabrinuti za njegovo zdravlje.
Many social media users wrote that they are worried about his health.
Charles je odavno poznat po debelim prstima, koje neki Britanci u šali zovu kobasicama.
Charles has long been known for his thick fingers, which some Britons jokingly call sausages.
Neki komentatori spominju probleme s cirkulacijom, a drugi posljedice liječenja raka.
Some commentators mention circulation problems, and others the effects of cancer treatment.
Rak je kralju otkriven 2024. godine.
The King was diagnosed with cancer in 2024.
Ni kralj ni Buckinghamska palata nikada nisu zvanično objasnili zašto su mu prsti otečeni.
Neither the King nor Buckingham Palace has ever officially explained why his fingers are swollen.
Charles se ipak više puta našalio na račun svojih ruku.
Charles has, however, joked about his hands several times.
U jednom BBC-jevom dokumentarcu rekao je princu Williamu da on nema „kobasice“ kao njegov otac.
In a BBC documentary he told Prince William that he does not have “sausages” like his father.
Britanska ljekarka Stephanie de Giorgio kaže da pacijenti često dolaze uplašeni zbog otečenih prstiju ili gležnjeva.
British doctor Stephanie de Giorgio says patients often come to her scared because of swollen fingers or ankles.
Prema njenim riječima, najčešće se ne radi o nečemu ozbiljnom.
According to her, it is usually nothing serious.

title: U Sarajevu otvorena izložba o književnici Meliki Salihbeg Bosnawi
Exhibition about writer Melika Salihbeg Bosnawi opens in Sarajevo
body: U Muzeju književnosti i pozorišne umjetnosti BiH u Sarajevu večeras je otvorena izložba „Neprijatelj“.
The exhibition “Neprijatelj” (“Enemy”) opened tonight at the Museum of Literature and Performing Arts of BiH in Sarajevo.
To je prva izložba posvećena književnici Meliki Salihbeg Bosnawi.
It is the first exhibition dedicated to the writer Melika Salihbeg Bosnawi.
Posjetitelji mogu vidjeti njene rukopise, fotografije, pisma i dokumente iz suda.
Visitors can see her manuscripts, photos, letters and court documents.
Izložba je otvorena do 5. decembra, a ulaz je besplatan.
The exhibition is open until 5 December, and entry is free.
Melika Salihbeg Bosnawi rođena je 1945. godine u Sarajevu i pisala je eseje, poetsku prozu i drame.
Melika Salihbeg Bosnawi was born in Sarajevo in 1945 and wrote essays, poetic prose and plays.
Uhapšena je 1983. godine i osuđena u Sarajevskom procesu protiv grupe muslimanskih intelektualaca.
She was arrested in 1983 and convicted in the Sarajevo trial against a group of Muslim intellectuals.
Kaznu je služila u Foči, a puštena je 1985. nakon 73 dana štrajka glađu.
She served her sentence in Foča and was released in 1985 after 73 days of hunger strike.
Umrla je u augustu 2017. godine.
She died in August 2017.
Naziv izložbe dolazi iz pisma sudu u kojem se Melika potpisala kao „neprijatelj“.
The name of the exhibition comes from a letter to the court in which Melika signed herself as “enemy”.
Autorica izložbe Hajrija Osmanhodžić kaže da je Melika tako pokazala prkos i dostojanstvo.
The author of the exhibition, Hajrija Osmanhodžić, says that in this way Melika showed defiance and dignity.
Ona želi da posjetitelji vide Meliku kao književnicu, majku i vjernicu, a ne samo kao osuđenu ženu.
She wants visitors to see Melika as a writer, mother and believer, not only as a convicted woman.

title: Sedmica bez alkohola može poboljšati san i energiju
A week without alcohol can improve sleep and energy
body: Mnogi ljudi koji redovno piju alkohol misle da loše spavaju zbog madraca, kofeina ili ekrana.
Many people who drink alcohol regularly think they sleep badly because of the mattress, caffeine or screens.
Nutricionisti kažu da već jedna sedmica bez pića može primjetno poboljšati san.
Nutritionists say that just one week without drinking can noticeably improve sleep.
Bolji mogu biti i probava i energija tokom dana, piše magazin Real Simple.
Digestion and energy during the day can also get better, writes the magazine Real Simple.
Nutricionistica Alicia Galvin objašnjava da uz alkohol brže zaspemo, ali je san lošiji.
Nutritionist Alicia Galvin explains that with alcohol we fall asleep faster, but the sleep is worse.
Alkohol smanjuje REM fazu sna, a ljudi se tokom noći češće bude.
Alcohol reduces the REM phase of sleep, and people wake up more often during the night.
Zato mnogi nakon nekoliko noći bez alkohola spavaju dublje i ujutro su odmorniji.
That is why many people sleep more deeply after a few nights without alcohol and are more rested in the morning.
Neki ljudi tada i manje hrču.
Some people then also snore less.
Nutricionistica Kezia Joy kaže da će tijelo odmah biti bolje hidrirano.
Nutritionist Kezia Joy says the body will immediately be better hydrated.
To znači da u tijelu ima dovoljno vode, pa je manje i nadutosti.
That means there is enough water in the body, so there is also less bloating.
Prema njenim riječima, energija, raspoloženje i apetit postaju stabilniji, a koncentracija bolja.
According to her, energy, mood and appetite become more stable, and concentration better.
Sve to može se primijetiti već nakon jedne sedmice bez alkohola.
All this can be noticed after just one week without alcohol.

title: Borac večeras igra u Švedskoj protiv Mjällbyja
Borac plays Mjällby in Sweden tonight
body: Fudbaleri Borca večeras od 18:45 igraju u Švedskoj protiv Mjällbyja.
Borac's players play Mjällby in Sweden tonight from 18:45.
To je treće kolo glavne faze Konferencijske lige.
It is the third round of the Conference League league phase.
Borac je prvak Bosne i Hercegovine i želi osvojiti nove bodove u Evropi.
Borac is the champion of Bosnia and Herzegovina and wants to win new points in Europe.
U prve dvije utakmice Borac je osvojio tri boda i trenutno je na 14. mjestu.
In the first two matches Borac won three points and is currently in 14th place.
Mjällby ima četiri boda i nalazi se na 12. mjestu.
Mjällby has four points and is in 12th place.
Novinari kažu da je to jedna od najvažnijih gostujućih utakmica ove sezone.
Reporters say it is one of the most important away games of this season.
Pobjeda bi Borac približila mjestima koja vode u nokaut fazu.
A win would bring Borac closer to the places that lead to the knockout phase.
Dosadašnji učinak kluba opisuje se kao polovičan.
The club's results so far are described as half of what was hoped for.
Utakmicu prenosi Arena Sport 1, a tekstualni prenos možete pratiti na Klixu.
The match is shown on Arena Sport 1, and you can follow a text report on Klix.

title: Brkić u Bukureštu govorio o NATO-u i putu BiH u EU
Brkić in Bucharest spoke about NATO and BiH's path to the EU
body: Zamjenik ministra vanjskih poslova BiH Josip Brkić boravi u Bukureštu, gdje se sastao s rumunskim zvaničnicima.
Deputy Foreign Minister of BiH Josip Brkić is in Bucharest, where he met Romanian officials.
Razgovarao je s ministrom vanjskih poslova Danom Neculaescuom i s dvije državne sekretarke.
He talked with Foreign Minister Dan Neculaescu and two state secretaries.
Sastanci su održani prije ministarske konferencije Srednjoevropske inicijative.
The meetings were held before a ministerial meeting of the Central European Initiative.
Brkić vodi Komisiju za saradnju BiH s NATO-om, pa je zahvalio Rumuniji na stalnoj podršci.
Brkić chairs the BiH Commission for Cooperation with NATO, so he thanked Romania for its continued support.
Posebno je istakao važnost misije EUFOR Althea, koju je opisao kao ključan faktor stabilnosti.
He especially stressed the importance of the EUFOR Althea mission, which he described as a key factor of stability.
Dodao je da BiH ima 100% usklađenost sa zajedničkom vanjskom i sigurnosnom politikom EU.
He added that BiH has 100% alignment with the EU's common foreign and security policy.
Članstvo u Evropskoj uniji, rekao je, ostaje strateški cilj zemlje.
Membership in the European Union, he said, remains the country's strategic goal.
Kao prioritete naveo je usvajanje pregovaračkog okvira i što skoriju prvu međuvladinu konferenciju s EU.
As priorities he named adopting the negotiating framework and holding the first intergovernmental conference with the EU as soon as possible.
Naglasio je i da je potrebno na vrijeme provesti rezultate izbora.
He also stressed that the election results need to be implemented on time.

title: Zašto su Republikanci izgubili izbore u Americi
Why the Republicans lost the elections in America
body: Na izborima za Kongres 3. novembra Demokrate su pobijedile u Sjedinjenim Državama.
In the Congress elections on 3 November the Democrats won in the United States.
Prema projekcijama, imat će najmanje 255 mjesta u Predstavničkom domu.
According to projections, they will have at least 255 seats in the House of Representatives.
U Senatu bi mogle imati 54 mjesta, a možda i 56.
In the Senate they could have 54 seats, and perhaps 56.
Autor analize navodi četiri razloga za poraz Republikanaca.
The author of the analysis lists four reasons for the Republicans' defeat.
Prvo, kandidati koje je Donald Trump lično izabrao izgubili su u važnim državama, a anketa CNN-a pokazuje da je 38% birača najvažnija bila ekonomija.
First, candidates Donald Trump chose personally lost in important states, and a CNN poll shows that for 38% of voters the economy was most important.
Drugo, rat protiv Irana, koji je počeo u februaru, donio je žrtve i skuplji dizel.
Second, the war against Iran, which began in February, brought casualties and more expensive diesel.
Treće, neki demokratski kandidati su otvoreno kritikovali politiku prema Izraelu.
Third, some Democratic candidates openly criticized policy towards Israel.
Četvrto, stranka je postala vezana za jednog čovjeka, a Trumpa podržava samo 30% Amerikanaca.
Fourth, the party has become tied to one man, and only 30% of Americans support Trump.
Autor smatra da Trump ne preuzima odgovornost za poraz.
The author believes that Trump does not take responsibility for the defeat.
Dodaje da bi se Republikanci do izbora 2028. morali distancirati od njega, što smatra gotovo nemogućim.
He adds that by the 2028 elections the Republicans would have to distance themselves from him, which he considers almost impossible.

title: U oktobru u BiH registrovano više od 100 kineskih automobila
Over 100 Chinese cars registered in BiH in October
body: Kineske marke automobila sve su jače na tržištu u Bosni i Hercegovini.
Chinese car brands are getting stronger on the market in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
U oktobru je registrovano ukupno 1.153 nova vozila, a 107 među njima bilo je kineskih.
In October a total of 1,153 new vehicles were registered, and 107 of them were Chinese.
To je oko 10% tržišta, dakle skoro svako deseto novo vozilo.
That is about 10% of the market, so almost every tenth new vehicle.
Najbolji rezultat imao je Geely sa 40 registracija, a slijede Chery sa 20 i Changan sa 14.
Geely had the best result with 40 registrations, followed by Chery with 20 and Changan with 14.
Geelyjev najprodavaniji model je Starray EM-i, hibridni SUV koji košta oko 58.000 KM.
Geely's best-selling model is the Starray EM-i, a hybrid SUV that costs about 58,000 KM.
Od početka godine kineske marke imaju skoro 7% tržišta putničkih automobila, otprilike duplo više nego lani.
Since the beginning of the year Chinese brands have almost 7% of the passenger car market, roughly double that of last year.
Autor teksta smatra da to više nije slučajnost, nego trajna promjena.
The author of the text believes this is no longer a coincidence but a lasting change.
Kao razloge navodi povoljne cijene, bogatu opremu i sve bolju mrežu prodaje i servisa.
As reasons he names good prices, rich equipment and an ever better sales and service network.
Očekuje se da će uskoro stići i nove marke, a prva bi mogla biti Jetour.
New brands are expected to arrive soon, and the first could be Jetour.

title: Državljani BiH sada mogu dobiti vizu za Saudijsku Arabiju online
BiH citizens can now get a Saudi visa online
body: Saudijska Arabija je uvela nove olakšice za posjetioce iz BiH.
Saudi Arabia has introduced new easier rules for visitors from BiH.
Državljani naše zemlje sada mogu dobiti turističku vizu elektronski ili po dolasku na granicu.
Citizens of our country can now get a tourist visa electronically or on arrival at the border.
To je objavilo saudijsko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova.
The Saudi Foreign Ministry announced this.
Pored BiH, na listu su dodane i Srbija, Sjeverna Makedonija i Meksiko.
Besides BiH, Serbia, North Macedonia and Mexico were also added to the list.
Zahtjev se može podnijeti online, pa nije potrebno ići u ambasadu.
The application can be submitted online, so there is no need to go to an embassy.
Prema zvaničnoj stranici Visit Saudi, moguća je i tranzitna viza za kratke boravke.
According to the official Visit Saudi website, a transit visa for short stays is also possible.
Turistička viza važi za posjete rodbini i prijateljima, sajmove, konferencije i druge događaje.
The tourist visa is valid for visiting relatives and friends, trade fairs, conferences and other events.
Može se koristiti i za umru, hodočašće muslimana.
It can also be used for umrah, a pilgrimage of Muslims.
Za svaku vrstu vize vrijede posebni uslovi.
Special conditions apply to each type of visa.
U aprilu je i BiH ukinula vize za građane Saudijske Arabije, Omana i Bahreina tokom ljetne sezone.
In April, BiH also lifted visas for citizens of Saudi Arabia, Oman and Bahrain during the summer season.

title: Zašto su putokazi na autoputevima negdje zeleni, a negdje plavi
Why motorway signs are green in some places and blue in others
body: Ko putuje Evropom, brzo primijeti da putokazi na autoputevima nisu svuda iste boje.
Anyone who travels through Europe quickly notices that motorway signs are not the same colour everywhere.
U Bosni i Hercegovini, Švicarskoj, Italiji i Švedskoj oni su zeleni.
In Bosnia and Herzegovina, Switzerland, Italy and Sweden they are green.
U Njemačkoj, Francuskoj i Austriji putokazi su plavi.
In Germany, France and Austria the signs are blue.
Zelene putokaze imaju i Hrvatska, Srbija, Finska i Bugarska.
Croatia, Serbia, Finland and Bulgaria also have green signs.
Plave imaju još Norveška, Španija i Portugal.
Norway, Spain and Portugal have blue ones as well.
Razlog razlike nije greška ni nepoštivanje pravila.
The reason for the difference is not a mistake or ignoring the rules.
Boje određuje Bečka konvencija o saobraćajnim znakovima iz 1968. godine.
The colours are set by the Vienna Convention on Road Signs and Signals from 1968.
Taj međunarodni sporazum želi uskladiti znakove, kako bi vozači svuda razumjeli njihovo značenje.
This international agreement wants to harmonize signs so that drivers understand their meaning everywhere.
Konvencija predviđa da putokazi za autoputeve mogu imati zelenu ili plavu podlogu s bijelim natpisima.
The convention provides that motorway signs may have a green or blue background with white writing.
Svaka država bira jednu boju i mora je dosljedno primjenjivati.
Each country chooses one colour and must apply it consistently.

title: Bečki aerodrom dobio prijetnje za četiri leta
Vienna airport receives threats against four flights
body: Aerodrom u Beču je u srijedu u 8:50 dobio e-poruku s prijetnjom za četiri leta.
The airport in Vienna received an email at 8:50 with a threat against four flights.
Policija je rekla da je prijetnja apstraktna, a detalje nije objavila.
The police said the threat was abstract and did not release any details.
Avion kompanije Wizz Air, koji je letio iz Milana za Varšavu, sletio je u Beč.
A Wizz Air plane, which was flying from Milan to Warsaw, landed in Vienna.
Policajci su pretražili avion, ali nisu našli ništa sumnjivo, pa je nastavio put.
Officers searched the plane but found nothing suspicious, so it continued its journey.
Glasnogovornik policije Stefan Loidl rekao je da je prijetnja poslana e-poštom u Poljskoj.
Police spokesperson Stefan Loidl said the threat was sent by email in Poland.
Prijetnja je stigla i za let kompanije Finnair iz Helsinkija za Beč, koji je sletio prema planu.
A threat also came for a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Vienna, which landed as planned.
Aerodrom je naveo da redovan saobraćaj nije bio poremećen.
The airport said that regular traffic was not disrupted.
Slične prijetnje bile su i u drugim evropskim zemljama.
Similar threats were also made in other European countries.
Italijanski borbeni avioni pratili su Finnairov let iz Helsinkija do Rima.
Italian fighter jets escorted a Finnair flight from Helsinki to Rome.
U Bugarskoj su tri aviona sletjela ranije nego što je bilo planirano zbog prijetnji.
In Bulgaria three planes landed earlier than planned because of threats.
Avion koji je letio iz Dublina za Rim sletio je na francusku vojnu bazu Évreux.
A plane flying from Dublin to Rome landed at the French military base Évreux.

title: Toplane Sarajevo nude plaćanje duga na rate
Toplane Sarajevo offer payment of debt in instalments
body: Sarajevska kompanija Toplane objavila je nove mogućnosti za korisnike koji imaju dugove.
The Sarajevo company Toplane announced new options for customers who have debts.
Ko ne može odjednom platiti cijeli dug, može potpisati ugovor o plaćanju na rate.
Whoever cannot pay the whole debt at once can sign a contract to pay in instalments.
Broj mjesečnih rata zavisi od visine duga i od načina na koji će kompanija osigurati naplatu.
The number of monthly instalments depends on the size of the debt and on how the company will secure payment.
Neki korisnici su već potpisali dogovor o ratama, ali ga nisu mogli ispuniti iz objektivnih razloga.
Some customers have already signed an instalment agreement but could not keep it for objective reasons.
Oni mogu ponovo razgovarati s kompanijom i dogovoriti nove uslove plaćanja.
They can talk to the company again and agree on new payment terms.
Osim toga, Toplane će otpisati zakonske zatezne kamate ako korisnik plati cijeli glavni dug i sudske troškove.
In addition, Toplane will write off the statutory default interest if the customer pays the whole principal debt and the court costs.
Kompanija naglašava da se misli na ukupne sudske troškove, a ne na troškove jednog slučaja.
The company stresses that this means the total court costs, not the costs of a single case.
Glavni dug se može platiti odjednom ili na rate.
The principal debt can be paid at once or in instalments.
Nakon toga se potpisuje sporazum o otpisu kamata, a Toplane povlače slučaj iz Općinskog suda.
After that an agreement on writing off the interest is signed, and Toplane withdraws the case from the Municipal Court.
Sve informacije korisnici mogu dobiti u centrima za korisnike kompanije.
Customers can get all the information in the company's customer centres.

title: Rekord u Brazilu: na jednoj utakmici isključeno 51 osoba
Record in Brazil: 51 people sent off in one match
body: Na omladinskoj utakmici u Brazilu postavljen je novi Guinnessov svjetski rekord po broju isključenja.
A new Guinness world record for the number of sendings-off was set at a youth match in Brazil.
Sudija je isključio 43 igrača i 8 članova stručnih štabova, ukupno 51 osobu.
The referee sent off 43 players and 8 members of coaching staffs, 51 people in total.
Ako se računaju i dva člana uprave kluba Uberlândia, broj crvenih kartona je 53.
If two board members of the club Uberlândia are also counted, the number of red cards is 53.
Igralo se prvo polufinale državnog prvenstva do 20 godina u državi Minas Gerais između Uberlândije i Mamorea.
It was the first semifinal of the under-20 state championship in the state of Minas Gerais between Uberlândia and Mamoré.
Početkom drugog poluvremena isključen je jedan igrač Uberlândije, pa su na teren utrčali neki predstavnici tog kluba.
At the start of the second half one Uberlândia player was sent off, and then some representatives of that club ran onto the pitch.
Utakmica je zbog toga bila prekinuta 40 minuta.
Because of this the match was stopped for 40 minutes.
Nakon nastavka Mamoré je u devetom minutu nadoknade postigao gol za 3:1.
After the restart Mamoré scored in the ninth minute of stoppage time to make it 3-1.
Brazilski mediji pišu da je igrač Mamorea provocirao protivnike dok je slavio, a nakon toga je počela masovna tuča.
Brazilian media write that a Mamoré player provoked his opponents while celebrating, and after that a mass brawl began.
Sudija Fernando Patrick Drosghic Modesto napisao je da se tuča dogodila u 54. minuti drugog poluvremena.
Referee Fernando Patrick Drosghic Modesto wrote that the brawl happened in the 54th minute of the second half.
Zbog haosa i nesigurnosti nije mogao pokazati sve kartone i odlučio je završiti utakmicu.
Because of the chaos and lack of safety he could not show all the cards and decided to end the match.
Policiji je prijavio prijetnje protiv sebe, a rekao je i da su igrači Mamorea nakon utakmice razbili svlačionicu.
He reported threats against himself to the police, and he also said that Mamoré players smashed the dressing room after the match.
Prethodni rekord bio je 36 crvenih kartona, na utakmici u Argentini 2011. godine.
The previous record was 36 red cards, at a match in Argentina in 2011.

title: Bluetooth će biti znatno brži: usvojen novi standard
Bluetooth will be much faster: a new standard has been adopted
body: Organizacija Bluetooth SIG, koja razvija standard za Bluetooth, usvojila je novi način rada pod imenom HDT.
The organisation Bluetooth SIG, which develops the Bluetooth standard, has adopted a new mode called HDT.
Najveća brzina za uređaje s Bluetooth LE povećava se sa 2 na 7,5 megabita u sekundi.
The top speed for devices with Bluetooth LE rises from 2 to 7.5 megabits per second.
To je skoro četiri puta više nego do sada.
That is almost four times more than until now.
Novi način rada koristi složenije metode prenosa, pa isti signal nosi više podataka.
The new mode uses more complex transmission methods, so the same signal carries more data.
Proizvođači ga ne moraju ugraditi, a uređaji mogu smanjiti brzinu kada je signal slabiji.
Manufacturers do not have to include it, and devices can lower the speed when the signal is weaker.
Organizacija tvrdi da veća brzina ne troši više baterije, jer se podaci prenesu brže.
The organisation says that higher speed does not use more battery, because the data is transferred faster.
U prvim demonstracijama datoteka od nekoliko megabajta prenesena je za oko 4 sekunde, a sada je potrebno oko 16.
In the first demonstrations a file of several megabytes was transferred in about 4 seconds, while now it takes about 16.
Sigurnosni kodi za provjeru poruka također će biti duži.
The security codes for checking messages will also be longer.
Prvi uređaji s novom tehnologijom očekuju se početkom 2027. godine.
The first devices with the new technology are expected in early 2027.
Pametni satovi, pametne naočale i kućni uređaji mogli bi brže slati podatke telefonu.
Smartwatches, smart glasses and home devices could send data to the phone faster.
Za punu brzinu oba uređaja moraju podržavati HDT, ali će stariji telefoni i dalje raditi.
For full speed both devices must support HDT, but older phones will still work.

title: Divovski psi žive kraće: u prosjeku samo 8,9 godina
Giant dogs live shorter lives: only 8.9 years on average
body: Velika britanska studija pokazala je da divovske pasmine žive u prosjeku 8,9 godina.
A large British study showed that giant breeds live 8.9 years on average.
To je otprilike tri godine manje nego kod svih pasa zajedno.
That is roughly three years less than for all dogs together.
Studiju je vodio profesor Dan O'Neill s Kraljevskog veterinarskog fakulteta u Londonu.
The study was led by Professor Dan O'Neill from the Royal Veterinary College in London.
Istraživači su pregledali anonimne veterinarske zapise o 2,25 miliona pasa koji su liječeni 2019. godine.
The researchers looked at anonymous veterinary records of 2.25 million dogs that were treated in 2019.
Među njima je bilo 28.345 pasa iz 29 divovskih pasmina, a podatke za više od 4.300 detaljno su analizirali.
Among them were 28,345 dogs from 29 giant breeds, and they analysed the data for more than 4,300 in detail.
Tibetanski mastif živi najkraće, samo 4,8 godina, a ženke žive oko 0,8 godina duže od mužjaka.
The Tibetan mastiff lives the shortest, only 4.8 years, and females live about 0.8 years longer than males.
Najčešći uzrok smrti je rak.
The most common cause of death is cancer.
Čak 73,8 posto divovskih pasa imalo je bar jedan zdravstveni problem tokom godine.
As many as 73.8 percent of giant dogs had at least one health problem during the year.
Istraživači misle da brži rast kod ovih pasa vodi do bržeg starenja.
The researchers think that faster growth in these dogs leads to faster ageing.
Profesor O'Neill kaže da su divovski psi divni ljubimci, ali da njihova veličina ima visoku cijenu.
Professor O'Neill says giant dogs are wonderful pets, but that their size comes at a high price.
Prema njegovim riječima, kratak život ovih pasa trebao bi pokrenuti širu raspravu o uzgoju.
According to him, the short life of these dogs should start a wider debate about breeding.
On vjeruje da bi umjerena veličina mogla produžiti život tih pasmina.
He believes that a moderate size could extend the life of these breeds.

title: Kongres interventnih radiologa u Sarajevu: 49 predavača iz 14 zemalja
Congress of interventional radiologists in Sarajevo: 49 lecturers from 14 countries
body: U Sarajevu će od 6. do 8. novembra biti održan drugi kongres interventnih radiologa u BiH.
The second congress of interventional radiologists in BiH will be held in Sarajevo from 6 to 8 November.
Organizator je Udruženje interventnih radiologa i minimalno invazivnih terapeuta u BiH.
The organiser is the Association of Interventional Radiologists and Minimally Invasive Therapists in BiH.
Kongres će biti u hotelu Mövenpick, a očekuje se više od 200 učesnika iz različitih oblasti medicine.
The congress will be at the Mövenpick hotel, and more than 200 participants from different fields of medicine are expected.
Predavat će 49 stručnjaka iz 14 zemalja.
49 experts from 14 countries will give lectures.
Teme su nove metode u liječenju krvnih žila, ali i drugih organa, te zahvati na mozgu.
The topics are new methods in treating blood vessels, but also other organs, and procedures on the brain.
Interventna radiologija je grana medicine u kojoj ljekari liječe pacijente kroz male otvore na tijelu, pa su operacije često manje opasne.
Interventional radiology is a branch of medicine in which doctors treat patients through small openings in the body, so operations are often less risky.
Učesnici će dobiti i 13,5 bodova za stručno usavršavanje koje priznaje Evropsko vijeće za radiologiju.
Participants will also receive 13.5 credits for professional training recognised by the European Board of Radiology.
Među organizatorima i predavačima su ljekari s Klinike za radiologiju Kliničkog centra Univerziteta u Sarajevu.
Among the organisers and lecturers are doctors from the Clinic for Radiology of the Clinical Centre of the University of Sarajevo.
Predsjednik organizacionog odbora je docent doktor Deniz Bulja, šef odjela za interventnu radiologiju na toj klinici.
The president of the organising committee is Assistant Professor Dr Deniz Bulja, head of the interventional radiology department at that clinic.
Organizatori ističu da je cilj kongresa da se predstave savremene metode liječenja.
The organisers stress that the goal of the congress is to present modern methods of treatment.

title: Studentska lista predlaže četverodnevnu radnu sedmicu
The Student List proposes a four-day work week
body: Studentska lista u Srbiji predstavila je prijedlog novih pravila za radnike.
The Student List in Serbia has presented a proposal for new rules for workers.
Najviše pažnje privlači ideja o četverodnevnoj radnoj sedmici od 32 sata bez smanjenja plate.
The idea of a four-day work week of 32 hours without a pay cut attracts the most attention.
Ona ne bi bila obavezna, nego bi je poslodavci mogli izabrati sami.
It would not be mandatory; employers could choose it themselves.
Radnici bi nakon 12 mjeseci rada dobili ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme.
After 12 months of work, workers would get a permanent contract.
Ugovori na određeno vrijeme trajali bi najviše 12 mjeseci, a s istim radnikom bi se mogla potpisati najviše četiri.
Fixed-term contracts would last at most 12 months, and at most four could be signed with the same worker.
Dodaci na platu bili bi veći: 150 posto za rad praznikom, 110 posto za rad nedjeljom i po 50 posto za noćni rad i prekovremene sate.
Supplements to pay would be higher: 150 percent for work on holidays, 110 percent for work on Sundays and 50 percent each for night work and overtime.
Poslodavci bi morali objaviti raspon plate u oglasima za posao.
Employers would have to publish the salary range in job ads.
Prijedlog uključuje i tri mjeseca očinskog odsustva te penzije koje bi se usklađivale dvaput godišnje.
The proposal also includes three months of paternity leave and pensions that would be adjusted twice a year.
Autori kažu da sadašnji zakon ne štiti dovoljno radnike koji nemaju standardan posao.
The authors say that the current law does not protect workers without a standard job well enough.
Za sve ove promjene bilo bi potrebno promijeniti zakon.
All these changes would require amending the law.

title: Wembanyama sa 52 poena i 24 skoka srušio Dallas
Wembanyama beat Dallas with 52 points and 24 rebounds
body: Košarkaš Victor Wembanyama odigrao je utakmicu kakvu NBA liga do sada nije vidjela.
Basketball player Victor Wembanyama played a game the NBA has not seen until now.
San Antonio je pobijedio Dallas 112:111, a Francuz je postigao 52 poena.
San Antonio beat Dallas 112:111, and the Frenchman scored 52 points.
Uz to je uhvatio 24 skoka i blokirao osam šuteva za 34 minute igre.
In addition, he grabbed 24 rebounds and blocked eight shots in 34 minutes of play.
Pogodio je 16 od 28 šuteva iz igre i 19 od 23 slobodnih bacanja.
He made 16 of 28 shots from the field and 19 of 23 free throws.
Prema izvještaju, nijedan igrač u historiji lige nije imao takav učinak.
According to the report, no player in the league's history has had such a performance.
Najbliže tome je bio Bob McAdoo 1974. godine.
Bob McAdoo came closest to it in 1974.
Već na poluvremenu imao je 29 poena, 15 skokova i pet blokada.
Already at halftime he had 29 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks.
San Antonio je u jednom trenutku vodio sa 19 poena razlike, ali se Dallas vratio.
San Antonio led by 19 points at one point, but Dallas came back.
Naji Marshall je pogodio tricu minutu i 41 sekundu prije kraja i izjednačio na 111.
Naji Marshall hit a three-pointer one minute and 41 seconds before the end and tied it at 111.
